title: Google's 2003 Founding of the SRE Discipline
explainer: Site reliability engineering has a specific origin point: Ben Treynor Sloss describes agreeing around 2003 to start what Google called its Site Reliability Engineering team, defining SRE from the outset as 'what happens when you ask a software engineer to design an operations function.' That founding framing - treating reliability as a software engineering problem addressed with error budgets and automation, rather than a purely manual operations discipline - still shapes how the practice is taught today.
